title: Off-Grid Point-Scatterer Localization from Sparse Limited-Aperture Data via Hankel Completion
summary: We study the localization of $s$ distinct planar point scatterers from sparsely sampled single-incidence, single-frequency acoustic far-field data over a limited receiver aperture. Under the first Born approximation, the coherent data form a two-dimensional off-grid exponential sum and admit a low-rank Hankel representation. A limited aperture generally admits multiple aperture-admissible Hankel pencils with different lifted dimensions, sampling multiplicities, and Vandermonde conditioning.
